description: Search FAA aircraft types by manufacturer/model name, aircraft type code, or category code to discover 6–7-character manufacturer/model/series codes and browse specifications. Pass a code to faa_get_aircraft_type for specs or faa_search_registrations as manufacturerModelCode for exact registration matches, then faa_lookup_registration for details. At least one filter is required. Every response reports totalCount (all matches, not just this page); when more remain, it returns nextOffset — pass it back as offset to page forward.

aircraftType.description: FAA aircraft type code: 1–9, H (Hybrid Lift), O (Other), exact match. Trimmed and uppercased; blank is unset.

category.description: Aircraft category code: 1 (Land), 2 (Sea), 3 (Amphibian), exact match. Trimmed; blank is unset.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–200, default 25).

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return — pass the nextOffset from a previous response, with identical filters, to page forward (default 0).

query.description: Manufacturer and/or model name to match (full-text).

name: faa_search_aircraft_types

aircraftTypes.description: Matching aircraft-reference summaries for this page (up to limit).

items.description: A decoded aircraft-reference summary; use code with faa_get_aircraft_type for full specs.

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

category.description: Aircraft category (Land, Sea, Amphibian) as code + label.

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

code.description: 6–7-character manufacturer/model/series code — pass to faa_get_aircraft_type for full specs or faa_search_registrations as manufacturerModelCode for exact registration matches.

numberOfEngines.description: Number of engines; may be blank.

numberOfSeats.description: Number of seats; may be blank.

cap.description: The limit that was applied (present only when truncated is set).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_aircraft_type`: aircraftType is not 1–9, H or O. `invalid_category`: category is not 1, 2 or 3. `no_filters`: No search filter was supplied. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset to request the next page; absent when this page reached the end of the matches.

notice.description: Guidance when no aircraft types matched, or when more matches remain.

shown.description: Number of results on this page (present only when truncated is set).

totalCount.description: Total aircraft types matching the filters, across all pages. Always present.

truncated.description: Present and true only when matches remain beyond this page.

title: faa-aircraft-registry-mcp-server: search aircraft types
